claims: Gunther's real name is Walter Hahn.
Gunther is an Austrian professional wrestler in WWE.
Gunther had a 666-day record-setting Intercontinental Championship reign.
As of April 2026, Gunther is a former two-time World Heavyweight Champion.
As of April 2026, Gunther has retired legends including John Cena.
Gunther is currently active on the Raw brand.
Gunther is known as "The Ring General".
Gunther holds the record for the longest-reigning Intercontinental Champion in WWE history.
Gunther's Intercontinental Championship reign lasted 666 days.
Gunther defeated John Cena in a retirement match.
Gunther defeated Goldberg in a retirement match.
Gunther defeated AJ Styles in a retirement match.
As of April 2026, Gunther has been involved in feuds with Seth Rollins.
Gunther was born in Vienna, Austria.
Gunther is married to former NXT UK star Jinny.
Gunther and Jinny welcomed a child in December 2023.
There is a company called Gunther Maschinenbau.
Gunther Maschinenbau specializes in meat processing technology such as injectors and tumblers.
